subject.title: Session reset on abort settle timeout causes complete context loss (session amnesia)

question: Should OpenClaw automatically carry bounded prior-session context into a replacement session after provider-error abort/takeover, or should this issue be limited to preventing the takeover/message-loss path?
rationale: The source-traceable bug is real enough to keep open, but automatic context carry-forward crosses session reset semantics and security boundaries that code inspection alone cannot choose safely.

options.title: Sequence takeover fix first
options.body: Review, land, or replace the open takeover PR to stop the message-loss path, then keep this issue scoped to an explicit context-bridge design decision.

options.title: Approve bounded context bridge
options.body: Add last-N replay only for same session key, channel/thread, workspace, and auth profile, with tests proving clean resets and cross-boundary cases do not replay old content.

options.title: Reject automatic replay
options.body: Keep reset boundaries strict and rely on explicit memory/export/session-history surfaces instead of injecting prior transcript content into replacement sessions.

recommendation.title: Sequence takeover fix first
recommendation.body: Review, land, or replace the open takeover PR to stop the message-loss path, then keep this issue scoped to an explicit context-bridge design decision.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent session lifecycle, gateway session management, and product-surface history make this the best available owner for the reset/replay boundary decision.
